market_question: Will the US acquire part of Greenland in 2026?
reasoning: The market is overpricing the chance of the US acquiring part of Greenland by end-2026. Despite renewed Trump interest, Denmark and Greenland have repeatedly and firmly rejected any transfer of sovereignty or exclusive jurisdiction. A binding agreement would require Danish and Greenlandic consent, which is politically improbable; use of force is extremely unlikely between NATO allies. Historical precedents show similar ambitions never materialized.
evidence_points: Danish PM Mette Frederiksen called idea 'absurd' in 2019 and her government remains opposed
Greenland's Prime Minister Múte Bourup Egede has stated 'We are not for sale and cannot simply be taken'
No formal negotiations or even preliminary talks on territorial transfer are underway
US already has military basing rights under 1951 agreement; acquiring exclusive jurisdiction would need a new, unlikely treaty
sources_consulted: Reuters - Danish PM: Greenland not for sale (2025-01-15)
BBC News - Trump reiterates interest in Greenland (2025-03-10)
Politico - Experts skeptical of US acquiring Greenland (2025-02-20)
